gui_timing: TUI-first construction; D019 built opt-in first-release capability retained; exact later timing unresolved

requirements.requirement: Spatial project/workspace/session navigation with typed object identity; a selected session is not the task itself
requirements.falsifier: Changing selection silently changes command target or canonical membership

requirements.requirement: Artifact and diff review with exact source/output revision, producing operation, verification status and accessible linear alternative
requirements.falsifier: Pretty diff binds to mutable branch head or presents generated as accepted

requirements.requirement: Lineage view with parent/fork/attempt/context links and textual adjacency list
requirements.falsifier: Layout proximity is treated as causation, ownership or authority

requirements.requirement: Context comparison between named epochs/capsules; accepted instruction references distinguishable from generated summaries
requirements.falsifier: Comparison fabricates unavailable context or treats summary as instruction

requirements.requirement: Provenance inspection with source, transformation, evidence and scope; unknown accounting explicit
requirements.falsifier: Missing count becomes zero; screenshot or stream success becomes verification

requirements.authority: R-N accessibility target; INTERFACE later GUI
requirements.falsifier: Any required workflow has a mouse-only, image-only or unsupported AT path

requirements.requirement: One command/query model, schema versions, errors, receipts and projections; deterministic status
requirements.falsifier: GUI bypasses admission or changes a refusal into successful queueing

requirements.requirement: One Stop vocabulary, visible scope/boundary and honest local/remote/effect state
requirements.falsifier: Window close means Stop; interrupt is represented as external rollback

requirements.requirement: Detachable independent views; zero attach-triggered inference/index/actor launch
requirements.falsifier: Attaching another window launches work or closes the runtime-owned adapter
Cached authority enables control or replay loss is filled with invented prose

requirements.requirement: No canonical-state authority, credential custody or widened credential visibility
requirements.falsifier: Privileged shell bridge reads auth store or permits arbitrary canonical writes

requirements.requirement: Opt-in packaging, inert disabled state, no mandatory dashboard; full accepted capability retained
requirements.falsifier: Core boot depends on GUI, or disabled GUI starts updater/telemetry/model work

requirements.requirement: Bounded rendering/GPU/window/IME/DPI/animation/idle costs and exact phase measurements
requirements.falsifier: Unbounded surfaces or queues, blocked writer/control, hidden CPU cost

requirements.requirement: Incremental TUI migration, transferable meaning, discoverable compatible bindings/layouts
requirements.falsifier: User must learn a second meaning for steer, queue, stop, fork or configuration

requirements.requirement: No unmeasured productivity/savings/porting claim; full review cost
requirements.falsifier: Polish, framework choice or source availability is offered as benefit evidence

requirements.requirement: All ten controls remain representable when the exact route supports them
requirements.falsifier: A GUI affordance asserts unsupported route capability or removes a required control
